title: US government says Iran-linked hackers are disrupting American water and energy providers
summary: An updated government advisory warns that Iranian hackers are exploiting systems used by water and energy providers.
llm_summary: US government officials have issued a warning that Iranian hackers are targeting the systems of American water and energy providers. These hackers are exploiting vulnerabilities in the systems to disrupt operations, posing a potential threat to public safety and infrastructure. The advisory serves as a call to action for these providers to strengthen their cybersecurity measures to prevent such attacks.
